hook: An FBI 302 field report documenting a multi-hour aerial search mission at a classified U.S. military facility in 2025, during which a senior U.S. intelligence official and helicopter crews using FLIR, night-vision goggles, and the naked eye directly observed a 'super-hot' orb, a swarm of lights, and repeated formations of orbs flaring up and down in sequence over approximately 90 minutes.
why_it_matters: This document is significant because it is a contemporaneous, timestamped law enforcement interview of a senior U.S. intelligence official describing a UAP encounter corroborated simultaneously by multiple sensor modalities (FLIR, NVG, naked eye), ground-based LP/OP personnel, and military aircraft crews. The observed behaviors—an object outpacing a helicopter over 20 miles, breaking into sub-objects, and orb formations appearing to actively pursue military aircraft—are documented by credentialed government witnesses in an official FBI evidentiary format. The SECRET//NOFORN classification and the breadth of federal and state partners involved indicate this was treated as a serious operational security matter, not a routine anomaly report.

key_findings.finding: A 'super-hot' orb detected on FLIR at ground level accelerated to a speed exceeding the helicopter's pursuit capability, covering an estimated 20 miles before the crew broke off the intercept.

quotes.text: LP/OP confirmed the sighting then relayed they spotted an orb under FUR and described as "super-hot" hovering at ground level before heading bearing-from LP/OP.

[CALL SIGN 1], unable to match speed, broke off pursuit, however the co-pilot reported seeing under NVG something emerge from the two objects and then travel in a different direction and a high rate of speed.

key_findings.finding: The initial single orb split into two distinct objects, and a secondary sub-object was subsequently observed emerging from those two and departing in a different direction—all confirmed under night-vision.

quotes.text: LP/OP reported the orb was heading east and then south at a high rate of speed and then broke into two objects.
the co-pilot reported seeing under NVG something emerge from the two objects and then travel in a different direction and a high rate of speed.

key_findings.finding: Multiple sequential orb formations were observed flaring up one at a time in horizontal configurations and then extinguishing in reverse order, a pattern that repeated across different compass bearings over roughly 30 minutes.

quotes.text: From the naked eye perspective, the two orbs appeared to flare up and remain stationary side by side. They appeared to be oval shaped, orange in color with a white or yellow center and emitting light in all directions. After a few seconds, a third orb flared up below the two, and then another one below that one until there were four or five in total below the original two. After a few seconds the orbs began to flare down in reverse order while appearing to be stationary until visual was lost.
The orbs flared up one at a time in a horizontal formation and after approximately ten - fifteen seconds, flared down in the opposite order.
spotted a swarm of lights moving in all directions west of-with three distinct orbs in a triangle formation. After several seconds the orbs flared down and lost visual.

key_findings.finding: The primary witness noted that the FLIR camera on the helicopter failed to capture many sightings because the objects were positioned above the aircraft, outside the camera's angular range, leaving the record dependent on NVG and naked-eye accounts.

legacy_program_connections.reasoning: This is a 2025 multi-sensor UAP incident report involving a senior U.S. intelligence official at a classified military facility, precisely the category of contemporaneous, credentialed-witness case that AARO was established to collect and assess.

The incident occurred at a classified military site with LP/OP personnel, coordinated through a Joint Operations Center, reflecting the kind of military installation infrastructure historically associated with sensitive UAP-adjacent programs.

The FBI 302 format and 'USPER' (U.S. Person) designation, combined with a senior intelligence official as the primary witness, suggests this report was generated as part of formal disclosure or investigative processes that interface with congressional oversight.
